To banish these demons, the relatives of afflicted people could hire rituals specialist, doctors who claimed they could oust specters with drugs, or physicians like Yu Zhen who denied the demonic etiology altogether, but claimed they knew methods to cure possession symptoms. Chapter 13 will explain in more detail the ways in which common people tried to cure their mad-acting relatives, including cases in which they sought the help of both exorcists and physicians. In this chapter, I discuss the ways in which physicians explained and handled symptoms that resembled those of involuntary possession. $ ^{3} $ By possession, I refer to invasion by a non-human (or no longer human) force that could supposedly control the thoughts, acts, and speech of their victim.
